title: Safe internal transaction retry
statement: The system shall produce 0 lost updates and 0 serializability anomalies attributable to internal transaction retry.
rationale: TiDB's auto-retry caused lost updates and read skew (Jepsen 2.1.7).

acceptance_criteria.text: An interactive transaction whose read set changed is never silently retried; the client receives the serialization-conflict error.
The Jepsen-style suite run for at least 1 hour with internal retry enabled reports 0 lost updates.
